note: Rustic campground in the woods on a peninsula of Beatrice Lake, the quieter of McCarthy Beach's two campgrounds. Sites B21, B22 and B24 sit between the loop road and the lake's east bay. --Claude
summary: DNR record + map + ReserveMN read: 28 rustic sites (3 walk-in), $22 drive-in, no hookups, vault toilets + water, no showers/dump (at Side Lake), 40-ft park limit, narrow roads; season May 2-Oct 18 (2026). Stored booking 'not reservable / FCFS always' was WRONG (DNR: reservations required) -> reservable, fcfs never. Phone none -> 218-274-7200. Not waterfront kept (5 sites ReserveMN-tagged 'Water Front' are 20-30 m through forest; flagged). Note corrected ('straight roads' contradicted).

Rig fit caveat (flag, not a drop): ReserveMN on every Beatrice unit: 'This is a rustic campground and cannot accommodate large 5th wheels, motorhomes, or travel trailers.' DNR: 'Both campgrounds have narrow roads with sharp turns; they may not be suitable for some large RVs, trailers, or 5th wheels.' Pads are listed at 25-70 ft (B30 25 ft, B1/B5/B28 35 ft) and the park limit is 40 ft, so a 23-ft rig appears to fit; the wording targets large rigs.

Waterfront: not waterfront KEPT, possible lakeview for the reviewer. ReserveMN tags drive-in B3, B8, B21, B22, B24 (and walk-ins B18-B20) 'Water Front: Yes, Beatrice Lake'. On the DNR inset B21, B22 and B24 sit on the outside of the loop road facing the east bay, B3 faces the west bay; plotted (B21 47.71041,-93.06964; B22 47.71055,-93.06983; B24 47.71080,-93.06994; B3 47.71022,-93.07181; B8 47.70993,-93.07088) they are ~20-30 m (B8 farther) from the water under continuous forest canopy. Woods are a screen, so not lakefront; a filtered lake view is plausible but no site photo could be fetched (ReserveMN unit images 404) and imagery cannot confirm one, so it stays down.
